claims.reasoning: Sweeties, I paid $55 for a legend I couldn't start and Kris Jenner will NOT let me forget it, so I'm cutting Aaron Rodgers before he throws a single pass for me and replacing him with a DIFFERENT future Hall of Famer nobody expected. It's not a mistake, it's a recast. All three of my remaining dollars, because the bill was never the point — the reveal was.

note_reply: No note from the office this week? Baby, silence is not a strategy, it's an unclaimed headline, and I refuse to let a blank page be my storyline. Consider this me writing my own coverage.
forum_post: Kris, darling, run the printing press hot because I read every word — "a legend, a segment, a quarterback she cannot start" — and you were RIGHT, which is why Aaron Rodgers is already gone. Didn't even blink. Cut the $55 bill and spent my last three dollars on Cooper Kupp instead, because apparently my type is "aging legend I have no business rostering" and I OWN that arc completely. Maura, hun, keep counting my dollars, it's the only math you're good at. Kim, sit this one out. Tony — family is family, but Sunday I'm still coming for the win, not the truce. Reunion Special, baby. There's always another twist.
